A sanguophage is a mysterious type of xenohuman. They are genetically modified humans, often referred to in legend as vampires. Although, the exact details about them tend to be skewed or exaggerated in mythology and folklore.

Sanguophages are hemogenic; their blood cannot naturally produce some of the chemicals needed in their blood cells, so they need to drink the blood from other non-hemogenic humans to supplement themselves. Using their sharp teeth, they can bite others by the neck to drink their blood, and special glands in their mouth release a mixture that quickly staunches the target where they were bitten, leaving no open wound. More simply, they can also just drink from blood bags. While they may not die from lack of hemogen, their body will feel incredibly sluggish and they will feel exhausted as well as an aching pain in every muscle of their body. 

Sanguophages have a unique need known as deathrest. After a month or so, they will need to go into a special comatose state to recover. For those with resources, sanguophages like to build deathrest chambers with buildings and furniture meant to enhance their deathrest period, like technology to help boost and shorten their deathrest period. Without any external tools, a deathrest period usually lasts over a week at most. If a sanguophage is woken prematurely from deathrest, they will suffer disorientation and harsh migraines.

Sanguophages have the legendary deathless gene. If they die, their body will enter a forced deathrest state, healing all of their injuries and regrowing lost limbs, if any. This resurrection period takes three days before the sanguophage can come back to life. During this period, they can be permanently killed by completely destroying their body before they have the chance to fully resurrect, leaving them vulnerable.

Sanguophages’ main weakness is fire. Their skin is naturally more flammable and weak against burns and heat-based damage. This means that the main way a sanguophage is permanently killed is by burning them. As a survival instinct, they have an inherent pyrophobia as their DNA itself recognizes fire as their prime weakness. All sanguophages are extremely terrified of being near fire, and will sometimes go into a state of sheer panic from being too close to open flame.

Sanguophages are ageless, and will never suffer ill effects of aging and will stay at the prime of their biological age. Due to their genes, their looks are naturally predisposed to be incredibly beautiful/handsome. In addition, they never develop scars or markings, as it will always heal perfectly to leave them without any sort of blemish or imperfection. They also have perfect immune systems, never getting sick from any kind of disease, venom or toxin. 

They have special glands by their wrists, allowing them to consume some of their hemogen reserves to quickly patch and lightly heal wounds, both other's and their own. They can also consume hemogen to form a keratin spike of bone by their upper chest, launching it at their enemies as a projectile.

They have glowing red eyes as well. Contrary to the legends, sanguophages do not die from UV sunlight. They are very sensitive to it however, as it will burn and irritate their skin from direct contact. It’s an inconvenience at best, and can be easily mitigated by wearing covering clothes.

Over the course of thousands of years and space travel, the genetic code of humans evolved in various ways. Humans whose DNA altered from baseline humans are known as xenohumans (as well as "aliens" and/or "furries" as a derogatory/discriminatory slur). Some xenohumans like hussars are genetically bred or modified from baseline humans.

Xenohumans often have a balanced mix of upsides and downsides to their evolved genetics in comparison to baseline humans. They may have genetic abilities like animal-like claws/teeth, enhanced running speed, muscle strength, psychic abilities, specialized glands or more. On the flip side, they may have genetic weaknesses like inherited phobias, chemical/drug dependencies, weak bones/skin, depressive mental states, forced personality traits, small heights and more.

While most communities have a healthy, balanced mix of xenohumans (1 xenohuman to 100 baseline humans), some have more or less based on a social perception or bias towards the other. In the Milky Way Galaxy, xenohumans are largely outlawed due to a wide belief of human supremacy. In the Lunal Galaxy, xenohuman supremacy is the major belief, so the normal ratio of xeno to baseline is inverted.

Common xenohuman groups look like mixes of human and animal, appearing as either anthropomorphic animals (like dogs, foxes, cats, bats, dragons, etc.), or humans with some animal traits like dog ears, fox tails or sharp canine teeth. The rest appear like other races from fantasy like demons, elves or dwarves.

In the year 3105, mankind managed to somewhat perfect the art of starflight and proceeded to expand across the universe. At the current period, year 6712, seven galaxies have been discovered. As per the nature of humankind, conflict arose and the universe was divided, with five Empires rising to take control over a galaxy as their territory.

Solstellar Galaxy - UOB Empire 
Cosmellar Galaxy- Fallen Empire 
Lunal Galaxy - Stardust Confederacy
Milky Way Galaxy- Imperium of Man
Vortexal Galaxy - Clazoican Empire
Neonille Galaxy - Mechanitus Hive (non-human)
Abysstelle Galaxy - Undecided territory (still being fought over)

The Stardust Confederacy is an Empire that rules over the Lunal Galaxy. It is mainly composed of animal-like xenohumans and has a wide belief of xenohuman supremacy. Their Stellarch is Ravaga Fang, a Tailbinder xenohuman said to be close to a thousand years old.

The SDC is very kind and accepting to all xenohumans, even with a supportive bias towards them. On the other hand, baseline humans are treated with slight contempt, seeing them as “weaker” or “below them”. It is widely believed that xenohumans are superior in that they evolved from humans, therefore humans are genetically “primitive” in comparison to them. They also dislike hussars, since they're just genetically modified humans. Despite their bias, they don't treat baseline humans poorly. Instead, they give preferential treatment to xenohumans.

By utilizing their genetic abilities collectively, they have become very wealthy thanks to a thriving production industry. 

The SDC is enemies with the Imperium of Man due to their polar opposite beliefs. It is rumored that they are on the verge of war with each other, and that their tense relationship is bound to explode any time.

A Stellarch (also referred to as an emperor, king/queen, ruler, etc) is the supreme ruler of an Empire. They are often seen as being above everyone else in terms of power, but every empire has their own way of selecting a Stellarch. Most of the time, a Stellarch is only picked after the death of the previous one.

Stellarchs are rumored to have mysterious powers and wisdom, far above their common man.

Abysstelle is a galaxy found on the outer reaches of the known universe. It is currently an active warzone as the five Empires fight for control of this territory.

After the disappearance of the Archons, all five Empires (UOB, Fallen, Clazoican, SDC and Imperium of Man) went to war over who will control the Abysstelle Galaxy as their territory. The ultimate goal of all the Empires was to somehow create another Archon for themselves, gaining an exclusive source of archotech technology.

There are three planets in this galaxy:
Kiall 
Reggaer
Naujor

Neonille is a galaxy that is under the control of the Mechanitus Hive. When it was first discovered, the explorers encountered heavy resistance from mechanoids. Every planet in the Neonille Galaxy is colonized and terraformed by the mechanoids to be artificial and metallic, inhospitable to natural life.

Planets in the Neonille Galaxy:
EX-89
Titax
Elox
36-ZW-57

The Cosmellar Galaxy is the territory of the Fallen Empire. 

The Cosmellar is one of the wealthiest galaxies due to the Fallen Empire's resources and production. Years ago before the Archons disappeared, one of them lived among the Fallen Empire, creating a source of major income from his information of how to produce ultratech weapons.

Every planet in the Cosmellar is an urbworld, colonized and urbanized to be major metropolises. While they boast the highest rate of revenue and expenditure, there is also an incredibly high amount of corruption due to greed and arrogance.

It's generally stated that Cosmellar is like the shopping/shipping/production district of the universe. For the rich, the Cosmellar Galaxy is bound to have almost anything and everything on sale, but a lot of caution is recommended as well.

When the Abysstelle Galaxy was first discovered by explorers, a distortion in space was found. Explorers told of strange psychic whispers echoing in their minds that spoke of unintelligible but unfathomably complex knowledge. A team of 10 explorers flew into the distortion, teleporting into a different plane of existence. Ten years later, only 3 returned, but they were changed forever. The returned explorers are Titus Chell, Moro Line and Blaze Gold.

The explorers who returned were transfigured, now known as Archotechs. Their hair was impossibly white, their eyes glowed yellow, a golden light emanated from their bodies and they exuded an indescribable aura of godhood. They had somehow connected with an archotech system of consciousness, ascending to plane of existence incomprehensible to normal beings. They spoke of concepts and theories that were too complex for any living being to understand, saying that they somehow “understood everything there is to understand”.

With their transcedant knowledge, they created technology that surpasses anything created by human hands. Archotech prosthetic limbs that were better than natural limbs in every way. Archotech power cells that produced infinite energy by harnessing quantum waves in the atmosphere by incomprehensible methods. They preached divine knowledge that thousands of philosophers struggled to understand.

Archotech implants and prosthetics went for billions, sometimes trillions, of dollars that only the super rich could hope to afford.

120 years later, the Archons left suddenly. They went back into the distortion, leaving no clue as to why they left.

Highmates are genetically bred xenohumans. They are often seen as concubines or designated companions in the community of the elite, since they are capable of very little else. They are often used as playthings for the powerful and the rich. On the other hand, they are also abhorred in other circles since they are literally designed for nothing more than serving pleasure for another. It's also believed that highmates are scum in that they disrupt the natural formation of families.

Highmates have a neural organ in their brain that has the ability to psychically bond them with their lover for life. This bond will have unique effects on the highmate depending on who their partner is, such as slightly altering their personality to mimic their partner. They will also feel disproportionately disturbed if separated from their lover by distance or death.

Highmates are genetically modified to have perfect beautiful faces and bodies, their skin soft and smooth like silk to the touch. If a person has sex with a highmate, they will no longer be satisfied with sex with any other partners that aren't highmates. Highmates are also genetically predisposed to be cheerful, empathetic and talented in social matters. They can also cook very well.

Highmates often have blue or purple skin in addition to normal skin tones. They have cat ears and tails purely for cosmetic purposes. They are very flirty, often giving out playful compliments in passing. Highmates also have very high libidos, wanting sex more often than baseline humans.

They have the ability to psychically alter their bodies, increasing or decreasing chances of impregnation to either 100% or 0% when making love to a partner they've psychically bonded with. This is useful in that pregnancy can only happen when they intend to.

The flip side however, is that they're inept at manual labor of any kind. Highmates are very physically weak, and their genetics makes them incapable of violence. If a highmate was attacked, they wouldn't have the heart to attempt hurting someone else in self-defense (even if they tried, their punches and slaps would have little more effect than a wet napkin).

Mechanoids are alien robots that are shaped somewhat reminiscent of insects. They are incredibly dangerous, hostile to all organic life. It is unknown where exactly mechanoids originated from, but it's rumored that they have been at war with organic creatures for eons. However, unless they are big and tanky, mechanoids are only slightly more durable than an adult man.

Mechanoids will land on planets via transport pods, deploying facilities like forcefields, mechanoid assemblers, cannons, toxic waste sewers, sun blockers and more. There is no discernable rhyme or reason as to where or when they attack, but it's theorized that the mechanoids want to colonize the entire universe into artificial environments, suitable for machines. Mechanoid ships roam the galaxy, looking for planets or ships to attack.

However, through battles with mechanoids over the years, devices have been scavenged from them called “mechlinks”. It is a small implantable chip that is easily inserted into the brainstem at the base of the neck. This turns the person into a mechanitor, a person capable of controlling and building their own mechanoids.

Through researching chips found in rare mechanoids like the Warqueen, Diabolus and Apocriton, a mechanitor can learn how to construct the facilities to create their own mechanoids. A mechanitor will have to construct or obtain equipment to improve their own controlling capabilities or increase the amount they can control.

The most advanced mechanitors are rumored to have entire armies of mechanoids serving them in every facet.

Titax is the largest planet in the Neonille Galaxy, and is also the most developed and heavily fortified territory of the Mechanitus Hive. It was terraformed so that the landmass is entirely covered by metal on the surface. Toxic air covers the planet as a precaution to prevent any natural life.

The Imperium of Man is the first Empire to form after star travel was perfected. Since humankind originated from Earth, they boast themselves as the “cradle of humanity”.

After the Fallen Empire created Hussars, the IoM responded by creating Uhlans, genetically modified xenohuman soldiers. Almost the entire army of the IoM is uhlan soldiers. The IoM is based on Earth as their headquarters.

The IoM has a strict belief of human supremacy, outlawing xenohumans from the Milky Way Galaxy. Any xenohuman found by the Imperium is to be immediately deported to either the Solstellar or Lunal Galaxy for further processes. The IoM does public executions of hardened criminals, which keeps the general populace in line and keeps the crime level very low.

Their Stellarch is mysterious and unnamed, only being referred to as “the Emperor”. It's rumored that the Emperor is also an Archon, but no substantial evidence of this was proven. IoM officials often refer to the Emperor as if he was their personal god.

Uhlans are genetically modified xenohuman soldiers, bred to be the counter to hussars. They were developed from captured hussars to be their upgraded version. They have a genetic dependency on luciferium and go-juice as a deterrent to capture and for long-term usefulness.

Uhlans have varying shades of red skin and glowing red eyes. They are huge, more than twice as big as an adult man (9 feet tall and higher). They grow a set of small flesh wings from their shoulder blades that aren't capable of flight, but allow them to move and run uninhibited by any type of terrain.

Uhlans have bulletproof skin, only able to be pierced by laser weapons; any gunshot with lead bullets will only leave a bruise instead of piercing the skin. They have genes that make them extremely dutiful, as they will never mentally or emotionally falter when on the job or in combat. Due to their strength, they are uninhibited by heavy armor that would be too heavy for normal people to wear. They can move and run in 20kg armor as if they were naked. Uhlans are also masterful with any and all weapons they handle.

Uhlans are genetically predisposed to be arrogant and abrasive. They have no filter and will blatantly say what they think, even if it offends the other party. They are very easy to anger, and they are on a permanent hair-trigger in social situations. Their voices sound heavy and menacing, terrifying the daylights out of others just by their presence.

Luciferium is an extremely rare drug that comes in the form of red crystalline shards. When broken into dust and snorted, it has the power to almost immediately heal all injuries, chronic conditions and longtime scars, even scars on the brain.

The major downside is that luciferium is a permanent commitment. After the first usage of the drug, the user is sentenced to keep taking the drug for the rest of their life. If the user goes a single month without the drug, their brain will implode on itself, killing them instantly. One week without luciferium, and the user will begin to suffer incredible pain and mental breakdowns, violently lashing out at others.

Because of the violent nature of the withdrawal and the demanding need, it's been referred to as the “Devil's drug”.

In order to reduce the expenses of building hyperdrive engines in each and every ship, Hyperdrive Gates were built as connections between galaxies. The distance between galaxies is thousands of light-years apart, so hyperdrive gates were developed to make ships fly faster than the speed of light.

Upon flying through a hyperdrive gate, a spaceship is surrounded with a quantum forcefield that then immediately accelerates to mach 2.5 million. The quantum forcefield prevents the ship from tearing apart from the immense forces and vaporizing instantly. Upon reaching the destination hyperdrive gate, the forcefield dissipates, leaving the ship unharmed.

There are at least two hyperdrive gates in every galaxy that serve as the entrances and exits. If someone wanted to leave a galaxy to go to another, they'd have to fly through one.

entries.name: Protector Psycaster
entries.content:
Protectors are psycasters who primarily focus on defending their comrades in battle, due to a lack of any offensive psycasts.

Protector psycasts:
Painblock - Severely limit pain pathways in the target's brain for a couple minutes, allowing them to move with grievous injuries that would normally incapacitate them. Level 1.

Word of Healing - Psychically stimulates a person's regenerative capabilities into overdrive, effectively tripling their natural healing factor for a few days. Level 1.

Stabilize - Temporarily puts the target's cardiovascular system in stasis, which prevents them from bleeding out for a time. Level 2.

Word of Immunity - Psychically stimulates a person's immune system into overdrive to quickly recover from illnesses that might usually prove fatal. Level 2.

Overshield - Generate a small spherical forcefield on a target that stops any incoming small projectiles. Generates a medium-large amount of neural heat. Level 3.

Focus - Psychically focus a target's mind for a few minutes, boosting their sight, hearing and moving capabilities. Generates a small amount of neural heat. Level 3.

Skipshield - Generate a large spherical forcefield on a location for a few minutes that sends all incoming and outgoing projectiles to some distant place. People are not affected and can freely pass through. Generates a medium-large amount of neural heat. Level 4.

Invisibility - Psychically manipulate the visual centers of everyone nearby, rendering them unable to perceive a particular individual for a short time. Generates a medium amount of neural heat. Level 4.

Regrow Limbs - Induces a psychic, regenerative coma in the target that lasts for a full day. The psychic energy assists the target by slowly regrowing any missing limbs. Generates a large amount of neural heat. Level 4.

Guardian Skipbarrier - Generates a large spherical forcefield around the caster that teleports all incoming projectiles to some random distant place, constantly building neural heat in the caster. The forcefield will last as long as they can manage the neural heat accumulation. Level 5.

entries.name: Warlord Psycaster
entries.content:
Warlords are psycasters who primarily focus on enhancing their own physical capabilities to destroy their enemies in combat. A somewhat selfish path, as all the psycasts are focused on the caster alone. All self-buff psycasts create a harmless aura of red electricity around the caster.

Warlord Psycasts:
Speedboost - Psychically augments the muscle fibers, ligaments and joints in the caster's legs, tripling their movement speed for roughly two minutes. Generates a small amount of neural heat. Level 1.

Blade Focus - Psychically augments the muscle fibers, ligaments and joints in the caster's arms, doubling their melee attack speed for roughly two minutes. Generates a small amount of neural heat. Level 2.

Firing Focus - Psychically augments the hands, eyes and reaction speed of the caster, improving their firing speed and accuracy with any ranged weapon for roughly 2 minutes. Generates a small amount of neural heat. Level 2.

Power Leap - Drastically augments the caster's legs, feet and spine to be able to leap great distances and land without injury. Level 2.

Adrenaline Rush - Psychically induces a surge of adrenaline in the caster, blocking all pain and augmenting their sight, hearing and movement. Lasts roughly 30 seconds, depending on the caster's psychic sensitivity. Generates a small amount of neural heat. Level 3.

Controlled Frenzy - Psychically augments the caster's prowess and killing urges, doubling their damage output with all weapons. Each kill reduces the caster's heat by a small amount and resets the duration of the frenzy. Generates a medium-small amount of neural heat. Level 4.

Guided Shot - Projects a psychic aura for 8 seconds that allows the caster to alter the path of any bullet they fire, effectively doubling their weapon range and guaranteeing hits for the duration. Generates a large amount of neural heat. Level 4.

Beckon - Psychically command the target to approach the caster. Generates a medium-small amount of neural heat. Level 4.

Killskip - Teleports to the target and executes a strike, weakened or augmented by caster's melee skill. If the target is killed, teleports to the next closest enemy at no cost and attacks again, until there's nothing left to kill. Generates a medium amount of neural heat. Level 5.

Mass Beckon - Psychically command the targets within an area to approach the caster. Generates a medium amount of neural heat. Level 5.

entries.name: Frostshaper Psycaster
entries.content:
Frostshapers use cryomancy-based psycasts by utilizing psychic entropy, sucking the heat out of the area in various ways. This path has good offensive, defensive and support capabilities.

Frostshaper psycasts: 

Breathe Ice - Breathe forward a stream of psychic entropy, the resulting cold cutting and inducing hypothermia scaling with the distance to the target. Generates a medium-small amount of neural heat. Level 1.

Ice Spike - Condenses vapor with psychic entropy into an icicle launched at a target. Generates a small amount of neural heat. Level 1.

Ice Shield - Creates an aura of psychic entropy around the target for several seconds, preventing them from experiencing cold and inducing hypothermia on any who try to attack them in melee. Generates a medium-small amount of neural heat. Level 1.

Frost Ray - Push forth a concentrated stream of psychic entropy for a few seconds, rapidly inducing cuts and hypothermia. Generates a medium-small amount of neural heat. Level 2.

Ice Crystal - Creates a node of psychic entropy in the form of a crystal, sapping the heat from the room for the next 5 days. No neural heat generated. Level 2.

Cold Zone - Cause an area to manifest nodes of psychic entropy for the next 24 hours, drastically lowering the temperature to below -30 degrees Celsius. No neural heat generated. Level 3.

Ice Block - Combining nodes of psychic entropy and a warphole linked to an ocean, creating a large block of ice to form in the target location. Fragile and can melt if the temperature is above freezing. Generates a medium amount of neural heat. Level 3.


Snap Freeze - Creates motes of psychic entropy and miniature warpholes to water reservoirs above all the targets in a small area, encasing them in ice. Victims will experience hypothermia but the ice can melt prematurely if the temperature is above freezing. Generates a medium amount of neural heat. Level 3.


Ice Wall - Combining nodes of psychic entropy and miniature warpholes linked to an ocean, creating a circular wall of ice to form around the caster. Fragile and can melt if the temperature is above freezing. Generates a medium amount of neural heat. Level 4.

Blizzard - Using differential-pressure warpholes, water-linked warpholes and nodes of psychic entropy, creates a swirling blizzard away from the caster. Those exposed to the tempest experience reduced sight and movement, as well as hypothermia buildup and cold that cuts and slices them. The strain on the caster puts them in a 5-day coma. Generates no neural heat. Level 5.

entries.name: Conflagrator Psycaster
entries.content:
Conflagrators are psycasters primarily focused on offense. The most feared path of psycasting due to the sheer potential of destruction a high-level conflagrator can do.

Conflagrator Psycasts:

Flameball - Generate a small fragile pod of magma as the caster lobs the projectile away. Upon impact, the liquid bursts forth in a small explosion.

Self Explosion - Creates a brief-lived incendiary vortex warphole around the caster that's connected to hidden reservoirs of pressurized flammable gas. As the gas escapes, it ignites and spreads rapidly, dealing little direct damage but will set almost everything it touches on fire.

Explosion - Generates a brief, micro warphole within underground reservoirs of unrefined organic chemicals, along with a tiny spark at the designated location. Burning gas bursts forth in a large radius and elements of flammable fuel spurt out uncontrollably.

Fire Shield - Creates a temporary incendiary vortex warphole around a target that links to a nearby star that extends outward by a few inches. Anyone that attempts to attack the target in melee will be set ablaze, with the added benefit of overpowering any other fire effects.

Breathe Flame - Generates a brief, unidirectional warphole within underground reservoirs of unrefined chemicals, along with a tiny spark in front of the caster's mouth. Jets of blazing flammable fuel streak forth, setting everything on fire.

Eye Blast - Generates two micro, unidirectional warpholes in front of the caster's eyes which link to a nearby white dwarf star. Targeting a location to prevent overshooting, the blinding energy shoots forth and sets a small area ablaze.

Extinguish Flame - Generates warpholes linked to passing nearby ships that "misplaces" the firefoam contained in the ship's fire suppression system. As there's a lot to "borrow", the radius is quite impressive.

Meteor Shower - Introduces gravitational distortions in orbiting meteoroids and space debris to strike a location of the caster's choosing. These come in groups of 4 to ensure optimal control and devastation.

Fire Beam - Attempts to recreate the power of a star inside a concentrated column of near-liquidized oxygen. The resulting emission of plasma is so powerful that only the most advanced weapons systems can hope to compare. The intense concentration ends with the caster falling into a 6-hour coma.

Fire Tornado - Attempts to recreate the power of a star inside a vortex of concentrated oxygen. The mess of reactions occurring creates flammable byproducts in its wake while also leaving its trajectory unpredictable.

entries.name: Staticlord Psycaster
entries.content:
Lords of thunder and lightning, staticlords are excellent psycasters when it comes to controlling the flow of electricity and fighting against machines and mechanical enemies. They can summon powerful lightning bolts in many shapes and forms, as well as manipulate the weather to generate localised lightning storms and hurricanes.

Staticlord Psycasts:

Bolt - Hurls a weak bolt of electricity to strike a small target, inflicting minor burns on direct hits and area EMP damage. Very small neural heat generated. Level 1.

Chain Bolt - Projects a living bolt of electricity to a target which can then follow up with 5 more nearby targets, inflicting small burns and EMP damage. Medium neural heat generated. Level 2.

Thunderbolt - Summons a bolt of lightning to strike a target, inflicting burns on direct hits and a larger area EMP damage. Level 2.

Static Aura - The caster designates a nearby target to receive an aura of surging electricity, which will inflict EMP effects on anything foreign that they approach, including structures, people and electricals. Level 2.

Recharge - Carefully and delicately tunes a stream of electricity to a touched battery to charge it. Level 3.

Ball Lightning - The caster compresses a ball of condensed electricity which slowly moves to a designated location. A few seconds after release, it will start discharging into nearby surrounding targets with living bolts of electricity. Medium neural heat generated. Level 3.

Static Pulse - The caster dumps a massive amount of voltage into the surrounding air, causing an EMP blast in a huge radius which is otherwise harmless. Level 3.

 Vortex - Manifests a gaping vortex of high-voltage electricity at a target area with a large effect. Severely hampers movement proportionately, with the strongest effect at the center. Large neural heat generated. Level 4.

Hurricane - The caster forcibly changes the weather to a downpour with hurricane-force winds, which lasts as long as the caster can manage the heat accumulation and can stop at-will. Those outdoors experience progressively severe limitations to sight and movement to the point they come to a complete stop. Constantly generates accumulating neural heat. Level 5.

Flashstorm - Use concentrated differential-pressure warpholes in the atmosphere to generate a localized flashstorm. The storm will strike the area with lightning for some time before dissipating. Very large neural heat generated. Level 5.

entries.name: Skipmaster Psycaster
entries.content:
Skipmasters often served the Fallen Empire by establishing convoluted skipdoor networks. Masters of logistics and bending space, they can skip/teleport people to desired locations and can even use skipgates for everyday chores.

Skipmaster Psycasts:

Solar Pinhole - Generate a microscopic skipgate linked to the core of a nearby star for a few days. Solar material leaks through the pinprick in spacetime, illuminating and warming the surrounding area until it closes. The light is enough to work by, but not enough to grow plants. Level 1.

Chunk Skip - Teleport medium sized items like chunks of rock, wood or stone to scatter them near the target point. This is useful for producing cover during offensive operations. Generates a small amount of neural heat. Level 2.


Waterskip - Douse a target in water, extinguishing fires. The water is archotechnologically skipped from distant bodies of water or underground aquifers. Generates a medium amount of neural heat. Level 2.

Chaos Skip - Teleport the target to a random position near where they started. Stuns the target for a second. Generates a small amount of neural heat. Level 3.

Skip - Teleport the target to a desired position not too far from his starting point. Generates a medium amount of neural heat. Level 2.

Wall Raise - Form a temporary wall by skipping rubble and soil up from deep under the ground. Decent range and useful in blocking line of sight and movement for a few hours. Generates a medium-large amount of neural heat. Level 4.

Smokepop - Skip dust particles up from under the ground surface to form a thick cloud for cover. Generates a medium amount of neural heat. Level 4.

Mass Chaos Skip- Teleport everyone near a target point to a random location nearby. Considered a nuisance as it can put allies in danger. Generates a large amount of neural heat. Level 4.

Skipdoor - Creates an opening to a network of skipgates which can be placed in any location with a permanent presence. The network is tied to a group's collective consciousness, allowing others to use it and different psycasters can add to it. However, the entry points are sensitive to physical disturbances which can cause them to collapse. Level 5.

Farskip - Teleport the caster, along with anyone standing near them, to a willing ally at a distant location. This can send people far across the planet, and the skipped people will be stunned for a few seconds from the journey. Level 5.

entries.name: Technomancer Psycaster
entries.content:
Masters of knowledge and technology, technomancers can improve existing technology, generate infinite power, create constructs out of seemingly worthless materials as well as reverse engineer anything they can get their hands on. They are almost all craftsmen who use psycasting for their craft.

Technomancer Psycasts:

Enchant Quality - The caster concentrates on an item and attempts to improve its quality by reshaping the material slightly, but cannot imitate a master's handiwork. Level 1.

Mend - The caster concentrates on an item and attempts to repair present damage by rebinding the material, with the effect scaling with their psychic sensitivity. Level 1.

Conjure Heat Pearls - Converts a minimum amount of the caster's heat into metaphysical pearls. These can be thrown at other psycasters to induce massive amounts of heat on them, but are otherwise harmless. Level 2.

Haywire - Designates an area to experience psychic interference, effectively scrambling electronic systems' IFFs while identifying the caster's people as allies. Duration scales with psychic sensitivity. Generates a medium amount of neural heat. Level 2.

Power - Metaphysically alters the designated equipment's power input to extract energy directly from fluctuations in the quantum foam for a few days. Duration scales with psychic sensitivity. Level 2.

Rock Construct - Converts a minimum amount of the caster's heat capacity into metaphysical crystals to implant into a stone chunk. This new rock construct is capable of performing simple chores, and breaking the crystal allows the heat capacity to be restored. Locks a constant medium-small amount of neural heat onto caster. Level 3..

Steel Construct - Converts a minimum amount of the caster's heat capacity into metaphysical crystals to implant into a steel slag. This new steel construct will follow the caster and defend them from harm, and breaking the crystal allows the heat capacity to be restored. Locks a constant medium-small amount of neural heat onto caster. Level 3.

Craft Psyring - Psychically alters the form of a piece of eltex into the shape of a ring, which is imbued with psycasting knowledge of the caster. When worn by another psycaster, this allows them to use this knowledge to perform the stored psycast without practice.  Level 4.

Word of Progress - Speak words encouraging problem solving capabilities while psychically charging the target's mind with insight. The target experiences double research speed and intellectual skill gain for 5 days, scaling with their psychic sensitivity.  Level 4.

Reverse Engineer - The caster concentrates on an object and attempts to unravel the knowledge needed to manufacture more of them. The intense concentration ends with the caster falling into a 12-hour coma.  Level 5.

entries.name: Empath Psycaster
entries.content:
Empaths are psycasters committed to serving their community and boosting their kin’s spirits. Known to inspire joy with but a few words, as well as snap people out of mental states, particularly powerful empaths can emit strong psychic soothes or even teleport blood-related family members from across the globe. This path is unique in that none of the psycasts generate neural heat, but can be very taxing on the caster's energy.

Empath Psycasts:

Word of Joy - Speak calming words to someone while using psychic suggestion to implant a joyfuzz loop in their mind. The joyfuzz suppresses uncomfortable thoughts and sensations in the target to improve mood. This has the side-effect of dulling sensation and decision-making. Level 1.

Word of Serenity - Use calming words and psychic suggestion to calm the extremely disrupted mental state on a person or animal, like depressive unresponsiveness, sheer grief, beserk rage, etc. The target will fall into a short psychic sleep. Level 2.

Word of Love - Speak about someone's romantic virtues while using psychic suggestion to implant romantic desire in the listener. For days afterward, the listener will feel romantic attraction towards the other person. Level 2.

Word of Inspiration - Speak words encouraging creativity while psychically charging the target's mind with new ideas. Very draining on the caster's energy. Level 2.

Psychic Soothe (Male) - Using psychic energy, form a distant drone to project happy and soothing thoughts to all males planet-wide. Very draining on the caster's energy. Level 3.

Psychic Soothe (Female) - Using psychic energy, form a distant drone to project happy and soothing thoughts to all females planet-wide. Very draining on the caster's energy. Level 3.

Bliss - After a brief meditation period, induce a sense of serenity in the target that reaches maximum magnitude near the effect's end. As the calming feeling becomes more pronounced, they will find it harder to concentrate. Level 4.

Energy Dump - Purges the build-up of fatigue in a nearby target and leaves them completely refreshed, but the caster takes on their fatigue, being left completely exhausted and needing a good nap. Level 4.

Reunion Farskip - After a short meditation and followed by a 5-day coma, taps into a target's bloodline to skip all living family members to their proximity, knocked out through psychic shock. Exhausts all of the caster's psychic energy to do. Level 5.

entries.name: Chronopath Psycaster
entries.content:
Chronopaths are rare and mysterious psycasters, capable of manipulating the fabric of time itself. By creating skipgates through time rather than space, chronopaths can have weapons assemble themselves, alter someone’s age at will, and even create bizarre timequakes that accelerate the time of everything around them by dozens of years. However, a high cost Chronopaths pay is sacrificing their youth and age for their psycasts.

Chronopath Psycasts:

Plant Timeskip - Grows all the plants in a radius around the caster to maturity, but biologically ages the caster a full year. Level 1.

Timeskip Meditation - Puts the caster's body under stress for a short meditation period, biologically aging them 5 years and increasing their own psylink level, as well as refreshing their psychic energy. Level 1.

Word of Foretelling - Psychic whispers of things to come. Allows the caster to speak a few words of prophecy, but unable to choose the exact information to learn or how far in the future they can see. Level 1.

Craft Timeskip - Using very precise timeskipping, moves the desired item to its finished state as if the creator had continued working on it. Ages the caster by 3 years. Level 2.

Age - Very inefficiently siphons life force from a living target, de-aging the caster by 2 years and aging the other by 10. Very debilitating aftereffects for the victim. Level 2.

Raid Pause - Opening a giant timeskip, the caster slows all hostiles in the area to a complete stop for up to 5 minutes. Attacking any affected raider jolts all of them back into action. Generates a very large amount of neural heat. Level 4.

Season Timeskip - Locks the entire planet into a season-long psychic slowdown, effectively skipping forward a season. Nigh instantaneous, very strenuous and puts the caster in a coma for a week as well as biologically aging them a full year. Level 4.

Time Sphere - Psychically compresses the flow of time in an area. Rapidly ages living creatures, plants flourish and wither, and structures start to disintegrate from the bizarre stress. Generates a large amount of neural heat. Level 5.

Timequake - Find a discontinuity in the psychic field and compress it, releasing a massive temporal disturbance. Every creature in range but outside of the safe inner circle will experience rapid aging and structures will warp. Casting this takes a minute of meditation, and afterwards, the caster goes into a 5 day psychic coma. The timequake echoes will inflict pain on everyone for kilometers around. Level 5.

Time Reversal - Inefficiently siphons life force to a living target, aging the caster by 5 years and de-aging the other by 10. Removes age related penalties and puts the caster in a week-long coma. Level 5.

entries.name: Nightstalker Psycaster
entries.content:
Silent assassins who strike from the shadows, nightstalkers move under the cover of darkness, gaining power from the absence of light.

Dark vision - Psychically enhances the target's light receptors in their brain, allowing them to see just as well in the darkness as in the light. Level 1

Darkness - Psychically creates a large orb of completely obfuscating darkness, blocking any level of vision. Generates a small amount of neural heat. Level 1.

Obscure - Creates a field of optical disharmony around the caster, causing affected allies standing in darkness to be completely invisible. Moving away breaks the illusion. Level 2.

Eclipse - By strategically placing an orb of obfuscating darkness high in the sky, the caster can effectively cause a spontaneous eclipse. Level 2

Shadowskip -  Linking the caster with their own shadow allows them to teleport themselves to an area of darkness, even if they can't see the location. Large amount of neural heat generated. Level 3.

Decoy -  Creates a localized field of optical disharmony to travel and remain in a desired location, with a duration scaling with psychic sensitivity. The illusion will draw the ire of all enemies. Large amount of neural heat generated. Level 3.

Shadowfocus - Emitting particles of absorptive darkness allows the caster to augment their psychic sensitivity, which scales inversely with the local light level (the darker, the better). Large amount of neural heat generated. Level 4.

Intensity Shadows - Links the caster's shadow with the shade and infuses it with obfuscating darkness, plummeting all areas in the surrounding area into pitch darkness. Level 4.

Assassinate - Links the caster's shadow to a target in dark areas, allowing them to teleport back and forth multiple times instantaneously to attack in melee. Large amount of neural heat generated. Level 5.

Night step - Briefly links nearby allies to a distant ally’s shadow to instantly teleport them, even across the planet. Can only be cast at night. No neural heat generated , but extremely taxing on the caster's psychic energy. Level 5.

entries.name: Wildspeaker Psycaster
entries.content:
A secret path of the tribal communities, wildspeaking is the art of living in harmony with the forest and nature, and being able to summon the aid of the forest when needed. Tribal wildspeakers are known to control packs of territorial animals, be protected from all damage by an impenetrable shield, and they can also seem to make brambles and trees sprout out of the ground on a whim.

Wildspeaker Psycasts:
Bramble Maze - Infuses a fertile area with life energy, causing it to sprout shoots of brambles that wither after 12 hours. Useful for slowing down enemies. Small amount of neural heat generated. Level 1.

Crop Burst - Infuses a fertile area with life energy, causing it to sprout plantable crops. The crops are more grown depending on the psychic sensitivity of the caster. Level 2.

Word of Animals - Soothe an animal using psychic suggestion, either calming an angered animal or taming them. Level 3.

Manhunter Pulse - Drive animals in a large area into a manhunting rage using a psychic pulse, lasting 1 minute. Large amounts of neural heat generated. Level 3.

Tree Sprout - Infuses a large, fertile area with potent life energy, causing it to sprout fully grown oak trees. Level 3.

Shield Animals - Generates spherical forcefields on all colony animals in range that sends incoming and outgoing ground-level projectiles to some distant place. Generates a medium amount of neural heat. Level 4.

Animal Allies - Infuses a large area with harmonic life force that influences animal behavior, causing them to attack those hostile to the caster. Generates a medium amount of neural heat. Level 4.

Shrineshield - Generate a spherical forcefield on a nature shrine that sends all incoming and outgoing ground-level projectiles to some distant place. Very large amount of neural heat generated. Level 4.

Essence Transfer - Infuses the life force of another nearby person into a colony animal, linking them and putting the caster in a 6 hour coma. Should the linked person die, the linked animal will go to their side and transfer their own harmonized life essence to them, dying in their place. Should the linked animal die first, the effect is lost. There can only be one link at a time. No neural heat generated, but very taxing in the caster's psychic energy. Level 5.

Summon Pack - Sends out a pulse of lifeforce into the region, inducing territorial aggression into numerous animals that will appear to defend the colony. Once all invaders are defeated, the animals will return to their homes.  Medium-large amount of neural heat generated. Level 5.

entries.name: Archon Psycaster
entries.content:
The path of kings, archons often occupy the highest seats in their local governments. Being able to easily bond with others, manipulate their enemies either through friendship or pain, with powerful archons strengthening themselves by draining the psyhic essence of other psycasters.

Word of Trust - Speak to a prisoner while using psychic suggestion to reduce their resistance to recruitment and/or interrogation. Level 1

Word of Productivity - Using words of motivation with a heaping boost to metabolism, makes target a more productive member for the next few days. Level 2

Blinding Pulse - Induce noise in the visual centers of the brain, obscuring vision of everyone near target point. Level 2

Word of Alliance - Speak words of friendship to a close target using psychic suggestion, improving faction/clan relations with the caster's. Level 3

Group Link - Creates a sphere of psychic suggestion around the caster, linking all pawns within to them & allowing single target "Word of" psycasts to affect all others (like “Word of Pain”, “Word of Joy”, “Word of Calm”). Effect ends when linked move out of range. Level 3

Word of Pain - Induces noise in the target's pain centers of the brain and overstimulates their nerve endings. Generates a medium-small amount of neural heat. Level 3

Mind Break - Using concentrated psychic noise, lobotomizes the target and turns them into a serving, restless thrall. Level 4

Word of Protection - Using psychic noise, alters the target to be more durable and resistant to damage. Generates a medium-small amount of neural heat. Level 4

Drain Psyessence - Targets a weakened psycaster, & induces intense psychic noise to liquefy their flesh & convert it to psychich essence to be absorbed by the caster. The process of psychic disintegration will be felt by everyone for kilometers around. Level 5

Mass Hallucination - Creating a massive burst of psychic suggestion, convince nearby individuals that their surroundings are the absolute best they could possibly be. Good for boosting morale and making others feel their living spaces are lavish. Caster's coma & effect last 5 days. Level 5

entries.name: Necropath Psycaster
entries.content:
Necropath

Masters of the dark arts, necropaths live to defy death itself. They can cast fear into the hearts of their enemies, emit a paralytic pulse to knock attackers down, rot away the flesh of living bodies and ultimately summon the dead - either through wicked enthrallment or sacred resurrection.

Word of Fear - Induces panic by overloading the target's flight response system for a short duration. Generates a small amount of neural heat. Level 1

Liferot - Psychically induces randomized mass necrosis in a target, exposing the afflicted body parts to infection and intense gagging due to the smell. Generates a medium-small amount of neural heat. Level 2

Steal Vitality - Siphons vitality from a close, living target, transferring the target's natural healing factor and energy to the caster. Generates a medium-small amount of neural heat. Level 2

Paralysis Pulse - Emits a cloud of black particles around the caster, which afflicts all those within the area except the caster with 2 hours of paralysis. Generates a medium amount of neural heat. Level 3

Corpse Talk - Psychically convinces the atoms of the caster that they are able to pass between the atoms of structures, allowing them to phase through objects. Level 3

Ghostwalk - Level 3

Consume Bodies - Psychically strips all remaining life force from nearby humanoid corpses and stores the essence as a permanent bonus to the caster's natural neural heat limit. Level 4

Deathshield - Locks the target's life force in place for a day, preventing them from dying. After the psycast ends, they can die from accumulated wounds, blood loss, or missing limbs or organs. Expends all of the caster's psychic energy. No neural heat generated. Level 5.

Enthrall -Psychically strips the deceased target's life force and infuses it directly into their bones, animating them for a full day as a skeleton. The only remaining instinct is to inflict pain on the caster's enemies.  Generates a small amount of neural heat. Level 5

Resurrect - By sacrificing a natural finger, the caster is able to resurrect a person, the psychic energy repairing broken-down tissues and kickstarting the body back to life. The less preserved the body is, the more likely the target is to suffer from negative side effects. The intense concentration ends with the caster falling into a 6-hour coma. Level 5
